# Tier 2 of lre-compat.yml (blocking): one image per package family lre/image
# knows. agent-plan.sh turns it into the tier2 legs and, for every runtime
# plugin (agents/runtimes/<id>/) that claims an image's family, an agents
# leg (agent-leg.sh).
#
# No pacman: Arch has no official arm64 image (archlinux is amd64 only). yum
# and xbps have no current official arm64 image either. The microdnf family
# is AlmaLinux's minimal image: Docker Hub's library rockylinux stopped at
# 9.3 (2024); AlmaLinux's is current and, being an official image, has
# lre/oci's mirrors when Docker Hub refuses.
#
# One image per line: <ref> <family> [<prep command>], as in tier3.txt
#   prep  what the agent must run before the install command on this distro,
#         the rest of the line (ripgrep is in EPEL on RHEL-likes)
debian:stable apt
ubuntu:24.04 apt
alpine:latest apk
fedora:latest dnf
almalinux:9-minimal microdnf microdnf install -y epel-release
opensuse/leap:latest zypper
